entities.summary: Olga Dmitrievna Arteshina is a Russian basketball player. Since 2000 she played in most international competitions for the Russian national team, except for the 2008 Olympics which she missed due to giving birth to a daughter; she won an Olympic bronze medal in 2004 and three gold and four silver medals at the world and European championships. At the club level she was the EuroLeague champion in 2005, 2013 and 2016.
